# Miataru client GetVisitorHistory API support (2026-01-19 19:19Z)

_**User**_

the miataru server knows about a /v1/GetVisitorHistory API that responds with a list of devices that have requested the location of a device. Does th emiataru client library support this call properly, refer to: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/miataru/miataru-protocol-specification/swagger/miataru-v1/api/swagger/swagger.yaml 


---

_**Agent (model default, mode Ask)**_


Searching the codebase for GetVisitorHistory support.

        "contents": "    private func sendLocationToServer(_ location: CLLocation) {\n        guard isNetworkAvailable else {\n            debugLog(\"No network available, skipping server update.\")\n            self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(\"No network connection\")\n            return\n        }\n        guard !settings.miataruServerURL.isEmpty,\n              let serverURL = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL) else {\n            self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(\"Invalid server configuration\")\n            return\n        }\n        guard let payload = sanitizedPayload(from: location) else {\n            debugLog(\"[LocationManager] Skipping server update due to invalid location values\")\n            self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(\"Invalid location values\")\n            return\n        }\n        self.serverUpdateStatus = .updating\n        Task {\n            do {\n                let success = try await MiataruAPIClient.updateLocation(\n                    serverURL: serverURL,\n                    locationData: payload,\n                    enableHistory: settings.saveLocationHistoryOnServer,\n                    retentionTime: settings.locationDataRetentionTime\n                )\n                if success {\n                    self.serverUpdateStatus = .success\n                    self.lastServerUpdate = Date()\n                    NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .didSendOwnLocationUpdate, object: nil)\n                } else {\n                    self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(\"Server response was not successful\")\n                }\n            } catch {\n                self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(error.localizedDescription)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n\n    /// Creates a sanitized payload to avoid encoding failures from NaN/inf values.\n    private func sanitizedPayload(from location: CLLocation) -&gt; UpdateLocationPayload? {\n        let longitude = location.coordinate.longitude",

        "contents": "    /// - Returns: A boolean indicating if the server acknowledged the update.\n    /// - Throws: An &#96;APIError&#96; if the request fails.\n    public static func updateLocation(serverURL: URL,\n                              locationData: UpdateLocationPayload,\n                              enableHistory: Bool,\n                              retentionTime: Int) async throws -&gt; Bool {\n                                  \n        let url = serverURL.appendingPathComponent(\"v1/UpdateLocation\")\n\n        var locationDict: [String: Any] = [\n            \"Device\": locationData.Device,\n            \"Timestamp\": locationData.Timestamp,\n            \"Longitude\": locationData.Longitude,\n            \"Latitude\": locationData.Latitude,\n            \"HorizontalAccuracy\": locationData.HorizontalAccuracy\n        ]\n        if let speed = locationData.Speed { locationDict[\"Speed\"] = speed }\n        if let battery = locationData.BatteryLevel { locationDict[\"BatteryLevel\"] = battery }\n        if let altitude = locationData.Altitude { locationDict[\"Altitude\"] = altitude }\n\n        let jsonPayload: [String: Any] = [\n            \"MiataruConfig\": [\n                \"EnableLocationHistory\": String(enableHistory),\n                \"LocationDataRetentionTime\": String(retentionTime)\n            ],\n            \"MiataruLocation\": [locationDict]\n        ]\n        \n        let data = try await performPostRequest(url: url, jsonPayload: jsonPayload)\n        \n        do {\n            let response = try jsonDecoder.decode(MiataruUpdateLocationResponse.self, from: data)\n            return response.MiataruResponse == \"ACK\"\n        } catch {\n            throw APIError.decodingError(error)\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Private Helper\n    \n    private static func performPostRequest(url: URL,\n                                          jsonPayload: [String: Any],\n                                          logMessage: ((String) -&gt; String)? = nil) async throws -&gt; Data {\n        do {\n            let data = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: jsonPayload)",

        "contents": "import Foundation\n#if canImport(FoundationNetworking)\nimport FoundationNetworking\n#endif\n\n// MARK: - Local Logging Helper\n\n/// Lightweight logging helper for the Miataru client library.\n///\n/// The main application target defines its own &#96;debugLog&#96; function, but it\n/// isn't visible inside this Swift package module. To keep the recent history\n/// logging changes compiling while still emitting useful diagnostics during\n/// development, we provide a local implementation that simply prints the\n/// message in debug builds.\nprivate func debugLog(_ message: @autoclosure () -&gt; String) {\n#if DEBUG\n    print(message())\n#endif\n}\n\n/// Configuration part of the Miataru request.\npublic struct MiataruConfig: Codable {\n    let RequestMiataruDeviceID: String\n}\n\n/// Strongly typed request body for the GetLocationHistory endpoint.\nprivate struct GetLocationHistoryRequestBody: Encodable {\n    var MiataruConfig: MiataruConfig?\n    var MiataruGetLocationHistory: GetLocationHistoryPayload\n\n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case MiataruConfig\n        case MiataruGetLocationHistory\n    }\n\n    func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {\n        var container = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        if let config = MiataruConfig {\n            try container.encode(config, forKey: .MiataruConfig)\n        }\n        try container.encode(MiataruGetLocationHistory, forKey: .MiataruGetLocationHistory)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Payload for GetLocation request.\npublic struct GetLocationPayload: Codable {\n    public let Device: String\n    public init(Device: String) {\n        self.Device = Device\n    }\n}\n\n/// Payload for the GetLocationHistory request.\npublic struct GetLocationHistoryPayload: Codable {\n    public let Device: String\n    public let Amount: String\n    public init(Device: String, Amount: String) {\n        self.Device = Device\n        self.Amount = Amount\n    }\n}\n\n/// Payload for the UpdateLocation request.\npublic struct UpdateLocationPayload: Codable {\n    public let Device: String",

Please take into consideration that this has the request-for-comment status and that it can change while there's work done on client and server applications.         "contents": "# MiataruAPIClient\n\nDieses Repository enthält ein Swift Package zur Nutzung der Miataru API sowie eine Beispielapplikation.\n\n## Struktur\n\n- &#96;Sources/MiataruAPIClient/&#96; – Das eigentliche Swift Package (Library)\n- &#96;Examples/MiataruTestApp/&#96; – Beispielapplikation und Dockerfile\n\n## Nutzung als Swift Package in Xcode\n\n1. Öffne dein Xcode-Projekt.\n2. Wähle im Menü: **File &gt; Add Packages...**\n3. Gib den lokalen Pfad zu diesem Ordner oder das Git-Repository an.\n4. Füge das Produkt **MiataruAPIClient** als Abhängigkeit hinzu.\n5. Importiere das Package in deinem Code:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n   import MiataruAPIClient\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Beispielapplikation lokal ausführen\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd Examples/MiataruTestApp\nswift run\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Beispielapplikation mit Docker ausführen (aus Projekt-Root)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ndocker build -f Examples/MiataruTestApp/Dockerfile -t miataru-testapp .\ndocker run -it --rm miataru-testapp\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Hinweise\n- Die Beispielapplikation sendet und liest Testdaten von https://service.miataru.com.\n- Passe ggf. die Device-IDs in &#96;main.swift&#96; an.\n- Die Library kann in eigenen Swift-Projekten verwendet werden. ",

            "lineNumber": 4

          {
            "text": "## Struktur",

          {

            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "## Nutzung als Swift Package in Xcode",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Öffne dein Xcode-Projekt.",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Wähle im Menü: **File &gt; Add Packages...**",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Gib den lokalen Pfad zu diesem Ordner oder das Git-Repository an.",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "4. Füge das Produkt **MiataruAPIClient** als Abhängigkeit hinzu.",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "5. Importiere das Package in deinem Code:",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;swift",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "   import MiataruAPIClient",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "## Beispielapplikation lokal ausführen",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },

0 || droppedInvalid &gt; 0 {\n            debugLog(\"[DeviceMapView] Normalized history for device \\(deviceID) dropped duplicates=\\(droppedDuplicates) invalid=\\(droppedInvalid)\")\n        }\n\n        return uniqueEntries\n    }\n\n    // Starts the auto-update timer for fetching location\n    private func startAutoUpdate() {\n        stopAutoUpdate() // Cancel any existing timer\n        let interval = Double(settings.mapUpdateInterval)\n        guard interval &gt; 0 else { return }\n        timerCancellable = Timer.publish(every: interval, on: .main, in: .common)\n            .autoconnect()\n            .sink { _ in\n                Task { await fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: false) }\n            }\n    }\n\n    // Stops the auto-update timer\n    private func stopAutoUpdate() {\n        timerCancellable?.cancel()\n        timerCancellable = nil\n    }\n\n    // Restarts the auto-update timer\n    private func restartAutoUpdate() {\n        startAutoUpdate()\n    }\n\n    // Shows the error overlay with a debug and user message\n    private func showErrorOverlay(_ debugMessage: String, _ userMessage: String) {\n        debugLog(\"Error: \\(debugMessage)\")\n        errorOverlayManager.show(message: userMessage)\n    }\n\n    // Aligns the map to north (heading = 0)\n    private func alignMapToNorth() {\n        ",

{
  "plan": "# Implement GetVisitorHistory API in Miataru Client Library\n\n## Overview\nThe Miataru server provides a &#96;/v1/GetVisitorHistory&#96; endpoint that returns a list of devices that have requested the location of a specific device. This endpoint is defined in the YAML specification but not yet implemented in the client library.\n\n## Implementation Details\n\n### 1. Data Structures (in &#96;MiataruAPIClient.swift&#96;)\n\nAdd the following Swift structs following the existing pattern:\n\n- **&#96;MiataruVisitor&#96;** (public struct, Codable)\n  - Properties: &#96;DeviceID: String&#96;, &#96;TimeStamp: String&#96;\n  - Computed property: &#96;TimeStampDate: Date&#96; (similar to &#96;MiataruLocationData.TimestampDate&#96;)\n  - Custom decoding to handle string/number timestamp formats\n\n- **&#96;GetVisitorHistoryPayload&#96;** (public struct, Codable)\n  - Properties: &#96;Device: String&#96;, &#96;Amount: String&#96;\n  - Similar to &#96;GetLocationHistoryPayload&#96;\n\n- **&#96;GetVisitorHistoryRequestBody&#96;** (private struct, Encodable)\n  - Property: &#96;MiataruGetVisitorHistory: GetVisitorHistoryPayload&#96;\n  - Note: Unlike &#96;GetLocationHistoryRequestBody&#96;, this does NOT include optional &#96;MiataruConfig&#96; per the API spec\n\n- **&#96;MiataruVisitorHistoryServerConfig&#96;** (public struct, Codable)\n  - Properties: &#96;MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory: String&#96;, &#96;AvailableVisitorHistory: String&#96;\n\n- **&#96;MiataruGetVisitorHistoryResponse&#96;** (public struct, Codable)\n  - Properties: &#96;MiataruServerConfig: MiataruVisitorHistoryServerConfig&#96;, &#96;MiataruVisitors: [MiataruVisitor]&#96;\n  - Custom decoding to handle malformed entries gracefully (similar to &#96;MiataruGetLocationHistoryResponse&#96;)\n\n### 2. Public API Method\n\nAdd &#96;getVisitorHistory()&#96; method to &#96;MiataruAPIClient&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\npublic static func getVisitorHistory(serverURL: URL,\n                              forDeviceID deviceID: String,\n                              amount: Int) async throws -&gt; [MiataruVisitor]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n- Parameters: &#96;serverURL&#96;, &#96;forDeviceID&#96;, &#96;amount&#96;\n- Returns: Array of &#96;MiataruVisitor&#96; objects\n- Throws: &#96;APIError&#96; on failure\n- Implementation pattern matches &#96;getLocationHistory()&#96;:\n  - Construct URL: &#96;serverURL.appendingPathComponent(\"v1/GetVisitorHistory\")&#96;\n  - Create request body with &#96;GetVisitorHistoryRequestBody&#96;\n  - Use &#96;performPostRequest(url:encodablePayload:logMessage:)&#96;\n  - Decode response with error handling and logging\n  - Return array of visitors\n\n### 3.
